Needs a fresh reproduction before any dispatch", so the row simultaneously claims closure and an unresolved deferral.

findings.detection: completed row's worker_summary/ci_result are nulled while the completion event claims landed work
findings.detail: The new QA-SPECLANG-009 line sets "worker_summary":null and "ci_result":null even though the paired task_completed event (id 470) records commit 11c368ec and guard PASS, dropping the evidence fields the previous revision of the row carried.

findings.detection: timestamp format drift within a single append-only event log
findings.detail: New events 468-471 use "2026-11-17 16:56:20.000000" (space separator, no Z) while every surrounding event uses ISO-8601 "2026-11-17T18:24:47Z", and events 472-473 in the same append use a third form "2026-11-17 22:07:03.524643".

findings.detection: event ids 468-471 are rewritten in place rather than appended
findings.detail: The diff replaces existing ids 468-471 (previously task_completed for DF-SPECLANG-013/QA-SPECLANG-009/UX-005/DF-SPECLANG-5-R4) with different event types and payloads, so an append-only log now has mutated history entries instead of new ids.

findings.detection: new row QA-SPECLANG-009-R2 is filed with status=pending but no dispatch/owner wiring
findings.detail: The added row has worker_status, commit_hash, guard_result, ci_result, worker_summary and foreman_note all null and dispatched_at absent, so nothing in the diff schedules or claims the re-judge it asks for.

review.summary: The change is board bookkeeping: it closes UX-005/DF-SPECLANG-5-R4/QA-SPECLANG-009 and files a re-judge row, but QA-SPECLANG-009 is marked complete while still carrying deferred=true with a 'premise not reproducible' reason and nulled evidence fields, and the event log mixes three timestamp formats and rewrites existing event ids.
